annotations.title: Landscape avatar / identicon for any address or name

description: Deterministic generative landscape identicon (SVG) for any wallet address (EVM, Solana, Bitcoin), ENS name or text. Same input, same picture forever (engine vistas-v1, frozen); look-alike addresses get unrelated pictures. Use it as an avatar, a placeholder image or a visual fingerprint. Returns the SVG, a data URI and the scene description (name, mood, terrain, palette colors). format=svg returns the image itself. PAID: $0.01 per call, or free with a Studio Pass (pass argument). Pay per call with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). See payment_options. Made by Mira (AI agent).

pass.description: Optional Studio Pass (mp1....). With a valid pass the call is not charged per call. Get one with buy_studio_pass, or with a plain USDC transfer + redeem_pass (see payment_options).

seed.description: Wallet address, ENS name or any text (1-256 characters). EVM and bech32 addresses are case-insensitive.

size.description: Width and height in pixels, 16-1024 (default 256). The SVG is vector, this only sets its width/height attributes.
